meta.name: Jacob Kirk
meta.summary: I build full-stack products, developer tools, and systems utilities with a strong interest in security, privacy, and reliability. Recent work spans Angular/Supabase production apps, local-dev automation, chargeback tooling, traceroute visualization, and MCP infrastructure.

about.body: I am a Computer Science major at the University of Central Florida focused on software development, security-minded systems, and tools that reduce friction for real users. I am especially interested in secure application design, network visibility, privacy-preserving workflows, and the kind of defensive engineering that keeps products dependable under pressure. I care about crisp interfaces, boring reliability, and codebases that another engineer can understand without a guided tour. I am looking for engineering opportunities where I can contribute quickly, keep learning from strong teammates, and ship work that earns its place.

projects.title: A-WELL Yoga
projects.description: Production site for A-WELL Yoga with marketing pages, live class booking, capacity tracking, internal attendance tools, Sanity content editing, Supabase Edge Functions, and Stripe checkout.

projects.title: DisputeShield
projects.description: Zero-budget browser SaaS that generates bank-ready chargeback evidence packets as PDF and ZIP files without uploading merchant files to a server, keeping sensitive evidence local to the browser.

projects.title: Eustis MCP
projects.description: Unofficial MCP server for UCF's Eustis Linux server with SSH command execution, SCP transfer, runtime diagnostics, and a bridge mode for sandboxed MCP clients.

projects.title: Devup
projects.description: Local development orchestrator that detects project dependencies, generates Docker Compose and env files, starts services, and verifies health from one command.

projects.title: NetTrace
projects.description: TCP-first traceroute visualizer with live hop streaming, geolocation, ASN/WHOIS enrichment, hop classification, export tools, and a Leaflet map UI for network visibility.

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A static, data-driven portfolio with an animated repo map, project filters, responsive layout, and a playable Snake mini-game.
